project.name: M-VAVE SMC-PAD Pocket Study and Setup Plan
project.objective: Create a reproducible knowledge base and operating setup for the M-VAVE SMC-PAD Pocket.

goals: Understand every physical control and operating mode.
Build reliable wired USB workflows before BLE MIDI.
Document host endpoints, mappings, presets, and firmware state.
Prefer Linux-native configuration and preserve editor-dependent settings.
